observed_defect: The visible causal V2 engine computed the latest completed feature row as entry_index minus one. When a finalized source event occurred inside a minute, that index was the still-forming event minute. The same future minute could also enter frozen high/low geometry. This violates the source-decision-second information boundary.

replacement.rule: Every market feature and structural boundary ends at the latest minute whose close time is no later than the finalized source timestamp. The next-minute open is realized execution only.
